headline: Emineon: AI-Powered Consulting OS
short_description: Emineon streamlines consulting workflows from lead to delivery, using AI to reduce admin time by 40% and increase client engagement by 60%. With features like skill-matching automation and a talent marketplace, it integrates with existing tools.
author: zer0-A1

sections.overview:
Emineon is an AI-powered productivity skill designed to streamline consulting workflows from initial lead through final delivery. It automates administrative tasks to reduce overhead by 40% while improving client engagement by 60%. The skill includes features like skill-matching automation and a talent marketplace, and integrates with your existing tools to minimize disruption.
Automating lead qualification processes
Generating client reports and documents
Matching consultants to projects based on skills
Streamlining project management workflows
sections.setup:
Terminal
Copy
`claude install zer0-A1/Emineon`
`git clone https://github.com/zer0-A1/Emineon`
sections.usage:
```
I'm a consultant at [COMPANY] specializing in [INDUSTRY]. I need to streamline my workflow from lead to delivery. Can you help me use Emineon to: 1) Automate skill-matching for my team, 2) Reduce admin time by at least 40%, and 3) Increase client engagement by 60%? I want to integrate it with my existing tools like [TOOL_1] and [TOOL_2].
```
Copy

```
# Emineon Workflow Optimization Plan
```
